speed_learning: Q4 KV itself changed generation speed only slightly. The large engineering gain came from Q4_K_M model weights and the optimized ROCm runtime: roughly 9-10 tokens/s versus about 1.4 tokens/s in the older BF16 CPU run.
boundary: This is a six-question development test on two private conversations. It detects a concrete Q4 degeneration but is too small and too difficult for the Q4-weight model to estimate an average quality loss across tasks.
privacy: The two source conversations and their hashes remain private. Only approved questions, expected facts, generated answers, manual scores, and aggregate timings are public.
